```yaml
name: SCCache Warmup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Midnight UTC every day
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  warmup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9
        with:
          version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Build debug workspace
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"
        env:
          SCCACHE_DIR: /tmp/sccache

      - name: Build release
        run: |
          cargo build --release
        env:
          SCCACHE_DIR: /tmp/sccache

      - name: Post sccache
        run: |
          sccache --show-stats
        env:
          SCCACHE_DIR: /tmp/sccache

  enable_sccache:
    needs: warmup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Enable sccache in attach-binaries-to-release.yml
        run: |
          sed -i 's|cache_provider:.*|cache_provider: sccache|' .github/workflows/attach-binaries-to-release.yml

      - name: Enable sccache in code.yml lint job
        run: |
          sed -i '/clippy:/,/cargo doc:/ s|cache_provider:.*|cache_provider: sccache|' .github/workflows/code.yml

      - name: Enable sccache in code.yml build job
        run: |
          sed -i '/debug workspace build:/ s|cache_provider:.*|cache_provider: sccache|' .github/workflows/code.yml

  notify_failure:
    needs: enable_sccache
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/MystenLabs/walrus/dispatches \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"event_type": "sccache_warmup_failed"}'
```

This workflow includes a daily scheduled job to warm up the sccache and another job to enable sccache in specific workflows. It also includes a notification step to alert the team if the warmup fails. The workflow is designed to run on Ubuntu and uses the latest stable Rust toolchain. The sccache installation and configuration are handled using the `mozilla-actions/sccache-action` action. The `enable_sccache` job modifies the specified workflows to use sccache as the cache provider. The `notify_failure` job sends a notification if any of the previous jobs fail.
